in_hindi.name: कान्वंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: वंश (vansh) means lineage or dynasty. कान्व (kanv) is a variant of the name Kans, a king in Hindu mythology. Therefore, कान्वंश (kanvansh) means the lineage or dynasty of Kans.

in_tamil.name: கான்வஞ்சம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kan is a variant of the name Kans, a king in Hindu mythology. Vansam means lineage. Therefore, கான்வஞ்சம் (kanvansam) means the lineage of Kans.

in_telugu.name: కాన్వంశమ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kan is a variant of the name Kans, a king in Hindu mythology. Vansam means lineage. Therefore, కాన్వంశమ్ (kanvansam) means the lineage of Kans.

in_marathi.name: Kanvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Kans
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kanva’ meaning descendant and ‘Ish’ meaning god. This name is given to boys in the Hindu tradition and symbolizes the strong lineage of the Kans dynasty.
